blind_read: Flickering bulb becomes giant banana, monkey jumps and points at it.

evidence.observation: Two short bright flashes separated by a 100 ms dim exposure draw the eyes overhead before the bulb gains a brighter halo.
A small crescent appears before the giant banana, then both feet leave the floor. The pointing pose holds for 1400 ms as the feet settle.

inspection: Inspected the decoded GIF exposures at native size, fur variants on cream and charcoal, and magnified drawings. Timing reconstructed from exposure durations; examined runtime hold/repeat and reduced-pose definitions.
